## bpTorch v0.1.0 — First Release

Blueprint-style visual editor for PyTorch neural architectures. Draw the graph, compile to `torch.nn.Module`, train, trace, and infer — all locally.

### Highlights

- **Executable visual graphs** — every canvas connection is a real tensor dependency
- **25 architecture samples** — Transformers, MLPs, training pipelines (25/25 train + infer verified)
- **Forward-only inference engine** — whole-graph and dual-flow interpreter modes
- **Interactive Blueprint tracing** — breakpoints, stepping, WebSocket tensor events
- **nanoGPT numerical parity** — verified against pinned `karpathy/nanoGPT`
- **Resizable bento workspace** — drag-to-resize palette, canvas, inspector, drawer

### Verified

| Suite | Result |
|-------|--------|
| Backend unit tests | 247 passed |

### Quick Start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/DJLougen/bptorch.git
cd bptorch && make setup && make dev
# → http://localhost:5173
```

See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for full details.
